# SSMS Engineers

> Manufacturer of pharmaceutical, food and chemical processing machinery — granulation, drying, blending, milling, coating and powder-transfer equipment engineered to GMP, cGMP, EU and US FDA design standards. Based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India; supplying to 10+ countries.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.ssmsengineers.com/): Company overview, product range, live events.
- [About SSMS Engineers](https://www.ssmsengineers.com/about): History (founded 2016), capabilities and compliance standards.
- [Products](https://www.ssmsengineers.com/products): Full catalogue of pharmaceutical processing machinery, grouped by section.
- [Contact](https://www.ssmsengineers.com/contact): Address, phone, email, enquiry form and map.

## Product categories

- Milling & Sieving: Vibro Sifter, Multi Mill, Co Mill, Colloid Mill, Super Mill
- Granulation: Rapid Mixer Granulator, Paste Kettle, Mass Mixer
- Drying: Fluid Bed Dryer/Processor, Tray Dryer, Vacuum Tray Dryer, Rotocone Vacuum Dryer
- Blending: Octagonal Blender, Double Cone Blender, Bin Blender
- Coating: Autocoater, Conventional Coating Pan
- Clean Air & Ancillary: Dust Extractor, De-Duster
- Liquid & Ointment Manufacturing: Liquid Manufacturing Plant, Ointment Manufacturing Plant
- Powder & Vacuum Transfer: PTS for Blender Loading, PTS for RMG Loading, PTS for Tablet Press Loading
